subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI permanently treat bootstrap configuration responses taking more than 15 seconds as unavailable and silently continue with defaults?
rationale: That cutoff converts eventual success into fallback behavior for existing deployments, and neither repository policy nor the submitted proof establishes that 15 seconds is the accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Compose and prove the deadline
options.body: Keep a bounded deadline, compose it with caller cancellation, cover slow and supplied-signal paths, and add actual-app before/after diagnostics before merge.

options.title: Accept the 15-second fallback
options.body: Land the current cutoff only after a Control UI owner explicitly accepts silent default fallback for responses exceeding 15 seconds.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Close or pause the PR if no user-visible failure or resource leak can be demonstrated beyond a background request remaining pending.

recommendation.title: Compose and prove the deadline
recommendation.body: Keep a bounded deadline, compose it with caller cancellation, cover slow and supplied-signal paths, and add actual-app before/after diagnostics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available ownership signal is the prior security and authentication work on this exact bootstrap endpoint.
